title: x1-validator-private-rpc settings
description: Every setting the tool reads. An override file may set any of them, and nothing else. hostname, publicIp and acmeEmail have no shipped value: the operator sets hostname before apply, and the other two only when wanted.

hostname.description: The rpc's hostname, such as x1-rpc.example.com: a dns name with at least one dot, and no scheme, path or port. Its A record must name the validator's public address.

publicIp.description: The validator's public ipv4 address, which nginx listens on. Leave it out to use the address the X1 network sees.

acmeEmail.description: A contact address for Let's Encrypt. Leave it out for none.

vaultPath.description: The vault that the x1-validator-services password unlocks.

nginxConfigPath.description: Where the tool writes nginx's main configuration.

njsModulePath.description: Where the tool installs the api-key check that nginx runs.

startWrapperPath.description: Where the tool installs the script that starts nginx with the api key.

systemdDropInPath.description: Where the tool writes the systemd drop-in that starts nginx through the start wrapper.

logrotateRulePath.description: Where the tool writes the logrotate rule for nginx's logs.

passwordCredentialPath.description: Where systemd keeps the saved, encrypted password.

keyHandOffPath.description: The memory-only file through which the tool hands nginx the api key at a start.

acmeStatePath.description: Where nginx keeps its ACME account and certificate.

acmeStagingDirectoryUrl.description: The ACME directory that apply --acme-staging uses.

acmeStagingStatePath.description: Where nginx keeps its staging account and certificate.

nginxLogDir.description: Where nginx writes the private rpc's logs.

logRetentionDays.description: How many days of nginx's logs logrotate keeps.

nginxWorkerPriority.description: nginx's worker_priority: higher runs at a lower priority than the validator.

websocketIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a quiet websocket subscription stays open: nginx's proxy_read_timeout.

certificateWaitSeconds.description: How long apply waits for the first certificate.

certificateWarningDays.description: How close to its expiry the certificate must come before ensure alerts.

exposedReminderMinutes.description: How often ensure repeats the alert while the rpc is public.

rateLimitRequestsPerSecond.description: How many keyed requests a second nginx forwards to the rpc. It also lets a burst of as many more through at once, and answers the rest 429 Too Many Requests. The shipped value is half of the 40 requests a second that Moralis's entry plan, Starter, allows an api key.

requestTimeoutSeconds.description: The time limit of each request the tool makes, and how long it waits for nginx to answer.

gatePollMs.description: How long apply and unlock wait between two looks at nginx's gate page, while they wait for it to say unlocked.

upgradeCheckPollMs.description: How long util/validate-nginx-upgrade waits between two looks at nginx or systemd, while it waits for a change.

startScriptQuietSeconds.description: How long after a change to the start script ensure keeps off it, on every run but the git hook's, so it never edits the script in the middle of an x1console update.

passwordMinLength.description: The fewest characters a new x1-validator-services password may have. It can only be raised.

passwordTries.description: How many times a password may be typed before a command that asks for it stops.

systemPath.description: An absolute path of letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores and slashes, safe to write into shell scripts, systemd units and nginx's configuration.

homePath.description: A path like systemPath, or one in the account's home folder, starting with ~/.

httpsUrl.description: An https url, safe to write into nginx's configuration.
